name: Chapter 2 Release
description: Chapter 2 launched as a major progression and content milestone.
highlights: Additional Chapter 2 content and progression became available through the July 30 update

name: Premium Pass Launch
description: The Premium Pass was introduced as a new game feature.

name: Lycaros World Boss Launch
description: Lycaros was introduced as a Weekly World Boss.
highlights: Lycaros added as a Weekly World Boss
source: Official Discord big-updates patch notes v1.1.6, 2026-08-09

name: Identify System Launch
description: The equipment Identify system was introduced using Magnifying Glasses.
highlights: Identify system added for Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, Upper Headgear, Middle Headgear, and Lower Headgear
Magnifying Glasses introduced as Lycaros drops for identifying eligible equipment
source: Official Discord big-updates patch notes v1.1.6, 2026-08-09

name: Guild System & Arcane Defense Launch
description: Guilds opened and Arcane Defense became available as a Guild activity.
highlights: Guilds begin with capacity for 15 members and can be upgraded to 30
Arcane Defense became available every Friday and is started by the Guild Leader
Guild activities award Guild EXP and Guild Coins
source: Official Discord v1.2.13 announcement and Guild reward-system announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20

name: Battle Pass Season 2
description: Battle Pass Season 2 was announced to begin September 1, 2026.
highlights: Announced rewards include Sunflower Crop, Fizz Drink, Mimic Chest Storage, Tier 5 Bag, +20 Soil, and the Enchanted title
source: Official Discord patch announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], v1.2.15
